perfil: Laru, dressed as the Holy Night Messenger, is on a special mission for the Snow Wish Festival. In the chiming bells at midnight, tin soldiers and saluting cannons will bear witness to a shimmering miracle.

habilidades.b: Wields the whip to perform multiple attacks. Carries toy: ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ to attack targets. When ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩'s Morale is fully stacked, it evolves into toy: ⟨General Curly⟩.

tpl.s: Wields the whip to perform multiple attacks. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Uses toy ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ to attack the target. Its Auto Attack deals ⟦5⟧ of ATK as Ignis Minion DMG and grants 1 stack of Morale. When ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩'s Morale reaches 20 stacks, it evolves into ⟨General Curly⟩. Its Auto Attack deals ⟦6⟧ of ATK as Ignis Minion DMG and consumes 4 stacks of Morale. When ⟨General Curly⟩'s Morale reaches zero, it devolves into ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩.

habilidades.b: Whips forward to attack the target, boosting the toys' Morale and triggering the Synergy Skill of the toys. The Main Skill can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and inflict Conflagration.

tpl.s: Whips forward to attack the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG and granting 1 stack of Morale to the toys. If the toys are within the Main Skill's Attack Range, they gain 1 additional stack of Morale. When casting the Main Skill, toys will cast the Synergy Skill to attack the target. ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ smashes the ground, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG, and gains 1 stack of Morale. ⟨General Curly⟩ swings dual blades, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG. Whip Assault (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and inflict Conflagration, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Ignis Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Commands the turret to fire Gift Box Shells at the target, dealing DMG and inflicting ⟨Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame⟩. The Gift Box Shell summons ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ upon explosion to continuously attack the target.

tpl.s: Snowish Laru commands the turret to fire 4 Gift Box Shells at the target. Upon hitting the target, each shell deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Skill DMG and then explodes to deal ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG. The Gift Box Shell summons ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ near the target. ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ attacks the target, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Ignis Minion DMG. Gift Box Shells inflict ⟨Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame⟩ upon dealing DMG.

habilidades.b: Transforms into toy: Dame Laru. After the transformation, her Auto Attacks become ranged shots, and her Main and Support Skills become Candy Barrage.

tpl.s: Transforms into toy: Dame Laru, gaining a shield equal to 35% of Base Max HP for 12s. Dame Laru cannot dodge or dash. Her Auto Attacks become shots that pierce targets, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Ultimate DMG. The Main and Support skills are replaced by Candy Barrage. Candy Barrage deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Ultimate DMG to targets in the front with a 4s cooldown.

builds.d: A build that enhances the toy army for cooperation, ideal for fighting a single enemy.
A build that enhances her own skills to perform multiple AoE attacks, ideal for fighting multiple targets.

l.b: Enhances the Synergy Skills of ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩. Enhances ⟨Clockwork Queen⟩'s shots.
l.s: Empowers the toys following Snowish Laru. ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩'s Synergy Skill deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG. ⟨General Curly⟩'s Synergy Skill deals ⟦1⟧ as AoE Ignis Minion DMG. ⟨Clockwork Queen⟩'s shots deal an additional ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG.

l.b: Casting Whip Assault or Candy Barrage (Main Skill) summons ⟨Clockwork Queen⟩ and boosts Morale for ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩.
l.s: Casting Whip Assault or Candy Barrage (Main Skill) summons ⟨Clockwork Queen⟩ and grants ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ or ⟨General Curly⟩ ⟦0⟧ stacks of Morale. ⟨Clockwork Queen⟩ attacks the target, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Minion DMG. Each of ⟨Clockwork Queen⟩'s attacks can trigger the Synergy Skills of ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩. ⟨Clockwork Queen⟩ can be summoned once every 18s.

l.b: ⟨General Curly⟩ deals DMG to nearby targets every second.
l.s: ⟨General Curly⟩ deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG to nearby targets every second.

l.b: When ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩ deal DMG to targets with ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, they have a chance to gain Morale and increase their Minion DMG.
l.s: When ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩ deal DMG to targets with ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, they have a 30% chance to gain 1 stack of Morale and increase their Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 8s.

l.b: Each toy present increases the Ignis DMG of all Snowish Laru's minions.
l.s: Each toy present increases the Ignis DMG of all Snowish Laru's minions by ⟦0⟧, up to 3 stacks.

l.b: Whip Assault (Main Skill) becomes a multi-hit attack.
l.s: Whip Assault (Main Skill) becomes a multi-hit attack, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG.

l.b: When Colonel Walnut and General Curly deal DMG, they inflict the Gift Box mark. Snowish Laru's skills deal additional AoE DMG against marked targets.
l.s: When Colonel Walnut and General Curly deal DMG, they inflict a Gift Box mark, lasting ⟦0⟧s. Whip Assault and Candy Barrage (Main Skill) deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG against marked targets.

l.b: Increases the Attack Range of Whip Assault (Main Skill). Increases the Ignis DMG of Whip Assault and Candy Barrage.
l.s: Increases the Attack Range of Whip Assault (Main Skill) by 20%. Increases the Ignis DMG of Whip Assault and Candy Barrage by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Whip Assault or Candy Barrage (Main Skill) lands a Crit Hit, increases Snowish Laru's ATK.
l.s: When Whip Assault or Candy Barrage (Main Skill) lands a Crit Hit, increases Snowish Laru's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, up to 9 stacks.

l.b: When Snowish Laru's Auto Attack lands a Crit Hit, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Snowish Laru's Auto Attack lands a Crit Hit, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s, up to 4 stacks.

l.b: When Snowish Laru deals DMG, she summons a Sled Turret to attack the target. When the Sled Turret lands a Crit Hit, increases the Ignis DMG of Snowish Laru and all toys on the battlefield.
l.s: Every 8s, Snowish Laru summons a Sled Turret to attack the target when she deals DMG. The Sled Turret deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Minion DMG and explodes to deal ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG. When the Sled Turret lands a Crit Hit, increases the Ignis DMG of Snowish Laru and all toys on the battlefield by ⟦2⟧ for 8s.

l.b: Snowish Laru can dodge one more time. Also, increases her DEF. Periodically, Snowish Laru becomes immune to direct DMG taken once.
l.s: Snowish Laru can dodge one more time. Also, increases her DEF by ⟦0⟧. Periodically, Snowish Laru becomes immune to direct DMG taken once. This effect can only be triggered once every ⟦1⟧s.

l.b: While transformed into Dame Laru, Snowish Laru's shots and Candy Barrage can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and inflict Conflagration. Increases Snowish Laru's ATK.
l.s: While transformed into Dame Laru, Snowish Laru's shots and Candy Barrage can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ and inflict Conflagration, dealing 40%/52%/64%/76%/88%/100% of ATK as Ignis Mark DMG. Increases Snowish Laru's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: While transformed into Dame Laru, casting Candy Barrage increases her Ultimate DMG.
l.s: While transformed into Dame Laru, casting Candy Barrage increases her Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases her Ultimate DMG each time Candy Barrage deals DMG.
l.s: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases her Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s each time Candy Barrage deals DMG, up to 10 stacks. This effect is removed if Candy Barrage is cast.

l.b: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad over time.
l.s: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad by ⟦0⟧ for 1s, up to 10 stacks. This effect is removed when the transformation expires.

builds.d: A Support build that enhances the cannon and deals massive damage.
A Support build that enhances the toy and deals continuous damage.

l.b: After a Gift Box Shell explodes, it deals DMG to targets within range over time.
l.s: After a Gift Box Shell explodes, it deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Skill DMG to targets within range every 0.3s for 2s.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG and Attack Range of Gift Box Shells. If the squad is Ignis-Trekker only, when Gift Box Shells deal DMG to the target, increases the Skill DMG Taken of the target.
l.s: Increases the Attack Range of Gift Box Shells by ⟦0⟧ and Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧. If the squad is Ignis-Trekker only, when Gift Box Shells deal DMG to the target, increases the target's Skill DMG Taken by ⟦2⟧ for ⟦3⟧s, up to ⟦4⟧ stacks.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG and number of shots of Courtesy Before Aggression (Support Skill).
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Courtesy Before Aggression (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧. Fires 2 additional Gift Box Shells.

l.b: When a Gift Box Shell deals DMG, increases the ATK of Snowish Laru.
l.s: When a Gift Box Shell deals DMG, increases the ATK of Snowish Laru by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, up to 6 stacks.

l.b: Increases the Ignis DMG dealt by Gift Box Shells to targets with ⟨Ignis Mark⟩.
l.s: Increases the Ignis DMG dealt by Gift Box Shells to targets with ⟨Ignis Mark⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Combines ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ into ⟨General Curly⟩. If the squad is Ignis-Trekker only, increases ⟨General Curly⟩'s Minion DMG over time.
l.s: When 4 ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ are on the battlefield, combines them into 1 ⟨General Curly⟩. ⟨General Curly⟩ swings dual blades, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Minion DMG. If the squad is Ignis-Trekker only, increases ⟨General Curly⟩'s Minion DMG by ⟦1⟧ every second, stacking up to ⟦2⟧ times.

l.b: ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩ learn skills, which they automatically cast to attack targets. General Curly's skill also increases its Minion Crit Rate.
l.s: ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩ learn skills, which they automatically cast after a ⟦0⟧s cooldown. ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ smashes the ground, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG. ⟨General Curly⟩ swings dual blades, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG and increasing its Minion Crit Rate by ⟦3⟧ for ⟦4⟧s.

l.b: Increases the combat duration and Crit DMG of ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩.
l.s: Increases the combat duration of ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩ by 50% and their Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩ deal Minion DMG to nearby targets over time.
l.s: ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG to nearby targets every second. ⟨General Curly⟩ deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Minion DMG every 0.5s.

l.b: Increases the ATK SPD of ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩. Each time they deal DMG, increases their Minion DMG; each time they land a Crit Hit, increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: Increases the ATK SPD of ⟨Colonel Walnut⟩ and ⟨General Curly⟩ by 35%. Each time they deal DMG, increases their Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Each time they land a Crit Hit, increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad by ⟦1⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: When the squad contains only Ignis Trekkers, Gift Box Shell increases the target's Ignis DMG Taken upon dealing DMG to the target.
l.s: When the squad contains only Ignis characters, Gift Box Shell increases the target's Ignis DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 12s upon dealing DMG to the target.

l.b: Each time Snowish Laru enters combat, increases the main Ignis Trekker's ATK.
l.s: Each time Snowish Laru enters combat, increases the main Ignis Trekker's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: While Snowish Laru transforms into Dame Laru, increases her ATK. Her shots and skill can inflict ⟨Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame⟩.
l.s: While Snowish Laru transforms into Dame Laru, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧. Her shots and Candy Barrage can inflict ⟨Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame⟩.

l.b: While transformed into Dame Laru, casting Candy Barrage increases her Ultimate DMG.
l.s: While transformed into Dame Laru, casting Candy Barrage increases her Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases her Ultimate DMG each time Candy Barrage deals DMG.
l.s: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases her Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s each time Candy Barrage deals DMG, up to 10 stacks. This effect is removed if Candy Barrage is cast.

l.b: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad over time.
l.s: While transformed into Dame Laru, increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad by ⟦0⟧ for 1s, up to 10 stacks. This effect is removed when the transformation expires.
